name: Takashina Toshio
source:
Toshio is a man who lives like a hermit in the "wild zone" with his [url=https://vndb.org/c69214]wife[/url], far from the city. His [url=https://vndb.org/c69214]wife[/url] and him has made this choice because they have lost their daughter during the disaster.

[spoiler]He is the true father of [url=https://vndb.org/c14897]Chimari[/url] and was a close friend of [url=https://vndb.org/c69174]Yukito[/url]'s parents.[/spoiler]
